legenda: Joyful Brazilian pagode with a roda de samba feel, male lead vocals singing in Brazilian Portuguese with a warm smooth voice and a group choir answering the chorus, cavaquinho, banjo, pandeiro, tantã, repique de mão, surdo and nylon guitar, a bridge with only cavaquinho and voice, festive backyard party mood, clean live-room production, high fidelity, professional mix
inspiracao: O PampaVision, que confere se a foto da vistoria mostra o carro do cadastro e manda as divergências para o olhar humano, cantado em roda de pagode.
descricao: Pagode com cavaquinho e pandeiro sobre o PampaVision, que confere modelo e cor nas fotos de vistoria veicular.
